data: This course aims to offer a comprehensive introduction to computer vision, focusing on how computers can make decisions by extracting information from digital images and videos. Key applications include robotics, manufacturing, and healthcare, where visual feature extraction, detection, and classification are essential functions. Students will learn fundamental concepts such as camera imaging geometry, feature detection and matching, multiview geometry (including stereo and reconstruction), and machine learning techniques like linear regression, logistic regression, and image classification along with brief overview of convolutional neural networks (CNNs).
